description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and the “Eval PPL” (Evaluation Perplexity) on the y-axis for three different model configurations from the Mixture of Hidden-Dimensions Transformer paper. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 100% to 25% in decrements of 25%, with tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks every 0.5 units. The red dashed line labeled “Only MoHD FFN” remains nearly flat, starting at approximately 11.6 at 100% and ending at 11.6 at 25%. The gray solid line with square markers, “Only MoHD ATTN,” begins at 11.6 at 100%, dips slightly to 11.5 at 75%, then rises to 11.7 at 50%, and ends at 11.8 at 25%. The blue solid line with star markers, “MoHD ATTN + MLP,” starts at 11.6 at 100%, increases to 11.8 at 75%, jumps to 12.1 at 50%, and sharply rises to 13.1 at 25%. The dark blue solid line with circular markers, also labeled “Only MoHD ATTN” in the legend, begins at 11.6 at 100%, rises to 11.8 at 75%, climbs to 12.2 at 50%, and steeply increases to 14.1 at 25%. All lines show increasing or stable perplexity as parameter ratio decreases, with the “Only MoHD ATTN” (circular markers) and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” configurations exhibiting the steepest degradation at lower parameter ratios.
